Name: Dreem's Mister Ginger Portraits
Author: Blakllyte
Description:
Wanted to do my own take on Mr Ginger from lemurkat's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger Mod[/url]﻿ in a style more that  closely mimics the vanilla one!

Go check out the mod, Mr Ginger is such a cute character and the original portraits are really nice too!

How to Install:

1 Extract the Zipfile into your SDV mods folder or move the extracted file there manually, whatever works for you
2 Thats it! Run SMAPI and talk to Mr Ginger to ensure that the portraits are working properly

Downloads.Description:
-Updated format for 1.6
-added a check for a certain event
-freshened up mr ginger's appearance slightly with brighter colors and some small mouth edits to make him look slightly less uncanny--his ears now emote!
